description: Narrows or widens a stereo pair, then pans it

params.text: Below the centre it folds the two channels towards mono; above it the difference between them is added to one channel and taken from the other, with extra gain on that difference over the top quarter
Moves the balance between the channels, hard left at -50% and hard right at +50%; the quieter side is scaled down and the louder side up to double

inputs.text: Shifts the width, a tenth of the knob's travel per volt, added to the knob and clamped at each end
Shifts the pan, 10% per volt, added to the knob and clamped at each end
Right audio in; with this jack empty the module reads 0V for the right channel rather than copying the left, so a mono signal comes out halved

outputs.text: The left channel after the width and pan stages
The right channel after the width and pan stages
